interpretation: Useful primary base advantage is excluded under both interval methods; pooled and donor remain unresolved under both, and uniform remains unresolved only under crossed resampling. All primary intervals include zero. Residual donor and pooled advantage remains unresolved under both methods; uniform excludes useful advantage under both. All residual intervals include zero. Raw sums retain useful base, pooled and donor uncertainty under both methods. All raw model-rival intervals include zero; raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods.
